title: Firebase security-rules contract
description: contracts/firebase-rules.json: where the app's Firestore and Storage rules and their emulator tests live, for firestore-rules-and-emulator-tests' check-rules-tests.mjs.

firestoreRules.description: Repo-relative path of the Firestore rules file (firebase.json firestore.rules), or null when the app has no Firestore.

storageRules.description: Repo-relative path of the Cloud Storage rules file (firebase.json storage.rules), or null when the app has no Storage.

testsDir.description: Repo-relative folder of the rules tests (*.rules.test.ts), run by jest.emulator.config.js inside firebase emulators:exec.
